Commentary.Commentary: ...THE CHASE...

South Africa Women will take this score. However, their bowling was poor. They were either too full or too short and were hammered away most of the time. South Africa Women though did well to end the innings well. The hosts have a good batting line up, we feel they will chase this down. What do you think?

Chamari Athapaththu was the star for the Lankans, she was batting on a different level while others were struggling. She made the scoreboard tick while Vishmi Gunaratne was getting used to the pitch. At one stage, both were going hard but both lost their wickets in consecutive deliveries and it didn't help them.

Excellent recovery from South Africa as at one stage it looked like Sri Lanka Women will post around 150 but the wickets of Chamari Athapaththu and Vishmi Gunaratne didn't help them. Still, this is a decent score and Sri Lanka Women will be happy with it.
A dot to finish the innings! On a length and on middle, Anushka Sanjeewani plays it back to the bowler. Sri Lanka Women end with 129.
On middle, Kanchana whips it behind square leg for a single.
Length ball, outside off, Kanchana swings her bat and hits it to deep mid-wicket for two runs. Pushes for the second. Brilliant.
Slower again on middle, worked to long on for one.
Bye! A slower length ball on off. Kanchana swings and misses but the batters take a quick bye.
Short and around off, Kanchana looks to pull but misses.
Full and outside off, drilled to long on for one.
OUT! BOWLED! A huge roar from Ismail! This is full and angling on middle. Nilakshi makes room to play on the off side but misses and the ball hits the stumps.
Full and outside off, Anushka Sanjeewani taps it to point for one.
Crucial runs! Slower ball on middle. Nilakshi looks to sweep but gets a top edge to short fine leg. The fielder there misjudged the height and lets it go away from here. Three runs.
On a length and outside off. Nilakshi steps across to scoop but misses.
Full, slow and outside off, dabbed to short third man for one.
On middle, eased to mid on for one more.
On middle, this is pulled to deep square leg for one.
Length and outside off, Anushka Sanjeewani slaps it to cover for one.
Bye! Outside off. Nilakshi de Silva slashes and misses. The keeper fumbles and a bye is taken.

OUT! TAKEN! Two in two for South Africa Women and this is the wicket they were looking for! Short and on middle. Athapaththu looks to pull but gets a top edge to deep square leg where Nadine de Klerk takes a sharp catch. End of a wonderful innings from the skipper.
Commentary.Howout: c Nadine de Klerk b Marizanne Kapp

Commentary.Commentary: OUT! RUN OUT! A direct hit and Vishmi Gunaratne is gone! South Africa Women needed something special! Around off. Vishmi Gunaratne taps it to point and calls for a quick single. She was a bit hesitant. Tazmin Brits at covers throws and scores at the bowler's end, finds Vishmi Gunaratne well short. Much needed wicket for South Africa Women.
Full and on the pads. Athapaththu looks to slog but gets hit on the pads.
Wide! Down the leg side, wided.
On middle, heaved to deep mid-wicket for one.
Rare dot! Full and outside off, Vishmi Gunaratne steps across and keeps it out.
On middle, smashed to long off for one more.
FOUR! Full and on middle, driven through covers for a boundary.
Full and on off, pushed to cover for one.
Full, slow and on off, hit to deep point for one.
On middle, worked to long on for one.
FOUR! Lucky one! Third time we have seen three boundaries in a row! Full toss, outside off, Athapaththu mistimes her cut to third man for four.
FOUR! 100 up in style! Full ball, outside off, Athapaththu smashes it over cover for a boundary.
FOUR! Another one! Length ball, outside off. Outside off, Athapaththu looks to cut but gets a faint edge past the keeper to the third man fence.
Fuller ball on middle, eased to long on for one.
A full toss, outside off. Vishmi Gunaratne drives it through covers for three more.
Fifty for Athapaththu! What a knock this is from the skipper! On middle, this is flicked to deep mid-wicket for one.
Nonkululeko Mlaba has hurt her bowling hand while trying to collect the throw. She looks in pain. The physio is out.
Flatter, slower and on off, holds up. Vishmi Gunaratne skips down and plays it to point for one.
Outside off, Athapaththu strokes it to deep cover for one.
Length ball on middle. Vishmi Gunaratne scoops it to short fine leg for one more.
Too full and on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Length ball on middle. Vishmi Gunaratne plays it late to third man for one more.
A single as this is hit to long on by Athapaththu.
Quick single! Outside off, guided to point for one more.
On a length and outside off. Vishmi Gunaratne keeps it out.
A single as this is hit to square leg.
On middle, played back to the bowler.
Dot! Short and close to off, Vishmi Gunaratne looks to dab but misses.
Wide! Ismail cannot finish this over quickly. Down the leg side, wided.
Outside off, slower, Vishmi Gunaratne looks to cut but misses.
FOUR! Three boundaries in a row! South Africa Women need to rethink their plan! Short and on middle. Vishmi Gunaratne looks to pull but gets a top edge behind the keeper.
FOUR! South Africa Women are leaking runs now! Poor bowling! This is short and outside off. Vishmi Gunaratne cuts it hard past point for a boundary.
FOUR! Well played! Full and on off. Vishmi Gunaratne stays back and heaves it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Length ball, outside off, late swing there. Vishmi Gunaratne fails to cut.
9 runs off the over! Full and on off, tucked to square leg for one.
FOUR! Vishmi Gunaratne gets into the act now! Too full and on middle. Vishmi Gunaratne sweeps it fine to fine leg for four more. Really clever.
On middle, this is swept behind square leg for two runs.
Wide! Slides it down the leg side. Vishmi Gunaratne looks to sweep but misses.
On off, played back to the bowler.
Full and on off. Athapaththu tries to drag but toe ends it high and it falls safely to mid off. One.
Pushes it wide outside off, Athapaththu flashes and misses.
Length and on off, kept out.
On the pads, bunted to square leg for one.
Outside off, tapped to point.
FOUR! Hat-trick of boundaries! Athapaththu you beauty! Goes short now on off, this is pulled over mid-wicket for four.
FOUR! Fifty up for the Lankans. Athapaththu gets to 40! This is crunched! Full and on off, this is driven hard past cover for four.
FOUR! Athapaththu continues to motor along! Length ball, outside off. Athapaththu lofts it over covers for a boundary.
On off, eased to long off for one more.
Quicker ball, outside off, Athapaththu looks to play at it but misses.
Full toss, outside off, Vishmi Gunaratne skips down and pushes it to cover. A shy at the bowler's end but the fielder misses.
Two runs! Flatter and on off. Vishmi Gunaratne laps it to fine leg for easy two.
Flighted full and outside off, knocked to mid off.
This is full and outside off, swept past square leg for a single.
On off, kept out.
On middle, pushed to point for a quick single.

FOUR! Athapaththu single-handily making the scoreboard tick. Short and on middle. Athapaththu looks to pull but gets a top edge. It flies high and drops in front of the fielder running from the deep square leg region. She tries to stop but it bounces and goes past her for four.
Full and on off, pushed to mid off.
Outside off, dabbed to point.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! Much needed one! This is angled outside off. Athapaththu looks to cut but goes off the outside edge fine to the third man fence.
On a length and outside off, Vishmi Gunaratne looks to cut but misses.
Steams in and full on off, kept out.
Length and on off, Vishmi Gunaratne punches it to cover.
Short and on middle, Athapaththu pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
This is on the pads. Athapaththu keeps it out.
On a length and outside off. Vishmi Gunaratne cuts it to third man for one.
A single! On the pads, nudged to deep square leg for a single.
Full and on middle, pushed to mid on.

OUT! TAKEN! The first wicket of the World Cup is here! Nadine de Klerk gets it! This is full and on off, swings in. Madavi looks to push but mistimes and it goes off the inner half straight in the hands of Tazmin Brits at mid-wicket. Madavi was struggling alot.
Commentary.Howout: c Tazmin Brits b Nadine de Klerk

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off again, Madavi fails to get bat on it.
On a length and outside off, Madavi misses his cut.
Length and on off, Madavi works it to point.
A dot but 10 runs off the over! Tossed up on off, Athapaththu mistimes his sweep to mid on.
Full and outside off. Athapaththu looks to heave but slices it over covers for two more.
In the air but falls safely! Around off, this is swept uppishly to mid on.
Short again, slow and outside off. Athapaththu looks to cut but misses.
FOUR! Two in a row! Athapaththu looking in good shape! Short and on middle, this is pulled to deep square leg for four runs.
FOUR! Good shot! Full and down the leg side. Athapaththu slog-sweeps it behind the keeper for a boundary.
7 runs of the over! Full and outside off, pushed to point.
A length ball, outside off. Madavi tries to push it across but misses.
On off, worked to point.
FOUR! Madavi gets one! This will help her alot! On middle on a length. Madavi scoops it behind the keeper for four runs.
THREE RUNS! Down the leg side, Athapaththu tickles it to fine leg. The fielder runs, dives and does well to save a run.
Full and on middle, swings in. Athapaththu defends it.
A single to end the over as this is pulled to fine leg for one.
FOUR! Here comes the first boundary! Pitched up, outside off, this is driven through covers for a boundary.
Kapp goes very full, outside off. Athapaththu fails to jam it out.
Slower length ball, outside off, Madavi pulls it over mid-wicket for one.
Madavi yet to find a connection! This is full and outside off, Madavi looks to drive but misses.
On middle, this is hit to square leg for a single.
A maiden by Ismail. Outside off. Madavi keeps it out.
Superb from Ismail. Full ball, outside off. Madavi looks to push but misses.
This is full and outside off. Madavi looks to slog but misses. Four dots now. Sri Lanka Women struggling.
Short in length and outside off, very close to the bat as Madavi looks to push.
Goes full now, outside off. Madavi looks to drive but misses.
A length ball on off. Madavi guides it to point.
Length and on middle. Athapaththu strokes it to cover.
On off, kept out.
Again swings back in, on the pads. Athapaththu misses his tuck again.
That was close! Length ball, around off. Athapaththu looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. Looked like it just nipped back in to miss the leg stump.
On the pads, flicked behind square leg for one.
Length ball, outside off, this is punched to mid off.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is Kapp.
Short in length on the hips, pulled to fine leg for a single.

Athapaththu is off the mark! A chance here! Short and on off, Athapaththu looks to pull but gets a top edge and it flies to the left of the keeper. Should have been taken but the keeper fumbles and allows it to roll to third man.
Three dots now! Swing and a miss! Short in length, angled across, outside off. Athapaththu slashes and misses.
On a length and on middle. Athapaththu drops it to cover.
On a length and on the pads. Athapaththu tucks it to mid-wicket.
Sri Lanka Women are off the mark! Short ball to start the proceedings. This is on middle, it is pulled to square leg for one.

We are all set. A huge attendance to kick off the World Cup. It is time for women's to make their name. Which team it will be? Time for the first match. The players are out in the middle. Shabnim Ismail to steam in first! Harshitha Madavi and Chamari Athapaththu to open for Sri Lanka. LET'S GO....
Gear up, folks! It's time for the World Cup to get going. First, it's time for the national anthems. It will be Lanka's first then of the hosts.

Sri Lanka Women (Playing XI) - Harshitha Madavi, Chamari Athapaththu (C), Vishmi Gunaratne, Anushka Sanjeewani, Nilakshi de Silva, Kavisha Dilhari, Oshadi Ranasinghe, Ama Kanchana, Sugandika Kumari, Inoka Ranaweera, Achini Kulasuriya.

South Africa Women (Playing XI) - Laura Wolvaardt, Tazmin Brits, Marizanne Kapp, Sune Luus (C), Chloe Tryon, Anne Bosch, Nadine de Klerk, Sinalo Jafta (WK), Shabnim Ismail, Ayabonga Khaka, Nonkululeko Mlaba.
Toss - South Africa Women have won the toss and will bowl first.

The Sri Lanka women, on the other hand, had lost to India Women in the Asia Cup finals. They will look to start their campaign with a win and leave back their previous loss. Their skipper, Chamari Athapaththu’s experience will be crucial and Inoka Ranaweera is the one to keep an eye out on the bowling front. Which side will come out on top? Let's find out together. Toss and team news to follow shortly...

Tick tock, tick tock - The timer is running down and it now for the womens to stomp their authority in the shortest-format, as we are ready to kick things off in the 2023 Women's Two World Cup. In the first match, it will be the hosts, South Africa Women locking horns agains Sri Lanka Women. Sune Luus' South Africa will be full of confidence after their recent T20I tri-series victory over India and the West Indies. In the finals, they defeated Harmanpreet Kaur's India by five wickets thanks to Chloe Tryon's 32-ball 57, which included six fours and two sixes. South Africa has chosen a combination of young and experienced players, hoping to gain from both worlds. Although the South Africa Women's team has always excelled in bowling, they have made a number of adjustments to their lineup to improve their batting as well. Shabnim Ismail, Marizanne Kapp, and Ayabong Khaka will be the key bowlers. Not to forgot, South Africa have a slight advantage as they will be quite familiar with the conditions. Sri Lanka Women, on the other hand, will be led by their most prolific run-scorer in the format, Chamari Athapaththu. Due to injury, Hasini Perera, one of Sri Lanka's top openers, will miss the World Cup. At the top of the list, she will be accompanied by Harshitha Samarawickrama who has been batting admirably in her most recent appearances, including a magnificent 81 runs against Thailand in the Asia Cup. Their side also includes Vishmi Gunaratne, who represented Sri Lanka at the U19 World Cup in South Africa. Nilakshi de Silva, Oshadi Ranasinghe, and Kavisha Dilhari are the other to watch out for. Which team will be first one to open their tally in the T20 Women's World Cup 2023? We shall find out together.
